correctness.rationale: Exact parity-complement identity and cyclic interval overlap give finite moments. A separated-block Lindeberg argument proves the growing-window CLT; Fourier factorization over widely separated signs independently establishes the limiting independence of global parity. These steps yield the Gaussian mixture and thresholds. A standard-library script checked all weighted disorder configurations through N=12 and representative large-ring moments; finite tests are auxiliary, not infinite proofs.

value.rationale: The theorem resolves the full distributional transition in the only logarithmic time layer immediately preceding Kac-ring half recurrence, distinguishing a centered Gaussian background from two parity-conditioned revival peaks. This sharp non-Gaussian profile is physically motivated by the irreversibility-versus-recurrence tension and improves the classical moment-level picture, with a reproducible benchmark for simulation.
